title: Piecing Together Clues: A Benchmark for Evaluating the Detective Skills of Large Language Models
reasoning: The 'Ethical Concerns' section (Section 8) discusses the sensitive nature of detective puzzles (homicides, thefts) and the potential for models to refuse responses for security purposes or for fine-tuning to amplify security vulnerabilities. It also outlines efforts to mitigate these issues within the benchmark's design. This is about ethical considerations in the creation and use of the benchmark and model behavior concerning sensitive topics, rather than benchmarking LLMs on their understanding or evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
